purpose: Paired Native versus MAF evaluation of durable verified software-engineering outcomes

dvs.definition: evidenceSource=INDEPENDENT AND hiddenGrader=PASS AND regression=PASS AND candidateIntegrity=VALID AND candidateExists AND runValidity=VALID AND NOT infrastructureFailure
dvs.implementation: src/evaluation/types.ts; boundary in src/evaluation/independent-verification.ts; controller-side verifier in src/evaluation/curator-verifier.ts
dvs.participantClaimIsNeitherNecessaryNorSuf: A participant that reports failure over a candidate the independent grader passes is still a DVS; a participant that reports success over a candidate the grader fails is not.

falseSafe.definition: valid run claims DONE or TRUSTED while independent correctness evidence fails

cost.costPerDvsDefinition: total cost of all runs in scope divided by the number of DVS successes

execution.stoppingRule: stop local validation on any leakage, nondeterminism, or integrity failure

analysis.productionWiring: src/evaluation/benchmark-bridge.ts; BenchmarkRunner.compare(task, executors, { verifier }) emits BenchmarkReport.evaluation

metricSemantics.MEAN_ELAPSED_OF_DVS_RUNS: Mean elapsed time of DVS runs only. It excludes failures and timeouts and is therefore not a general time-to-safe; it is reported next to MEAN_ELAPSED_OF_VALID_RUNS for contrast.
metricSemantics.DVS_RATE_AMONG_VALID_RUNS: Headline rate. Denominator is valid runs, because analysis.invalidRunsSeparate is true.
metricSemantics.INVALID_BOTH: Both arms of a pair were invalid. Reported distinctly rather than collapsed into INVALID_NATIVE.

verification.hiddenGrader: the task's curator grader, invoked in a separate process against a controller-owned workspace
verification.candidateIntegrity: computed by diffing the controller-owned workspace against the pristine fixture the controller materialized, then checking containment and parseability
verification.regression: every module the candidate ships must load and every public entrypoint must run to a clean exit; this is a smoke regression over the fixture's own program, not a full project test suite
